paragraphs: Start early by establishing control points, then follow field lines and measure boundaries. Return to the station at midday to process data and assemble maps. Visit the site again to verify any disputes. Produce deliverables and write reports in the afternoon. Before leaving, store instruments, archive materials, and prepare the next day's survey area.

In short: turn space into coordinates. Duties include establishing points, collecting field data, producing maps, verifying boundaries, issuing deliverables, and supporting acceptance. The work combines analysis with field activity and is the first checkpoint before engineering construction begins.
